text: This AI is nowhere near as intuitive as any others (some even completely free, just not on mobile) and it's been lobotomized to the point that it'll shut down if baked beans are in the prompt. The subscription offers poor value for money and doesn't match the expectations created by its promotion. I would not recommend this app to others.

Doesn't follow your prompts, and the daily sign in credits don't accrue, so there's no way to save them to generate video without paying for it first. If the image generator is any indication, the video wouldn't be worth it anyway. Uninstalling after I write this review.

I am very happy to revise my last review which went from 5 stars to 3 stars, but now after a year of waiting on the final major updates, I am pleased to return my review to 5 stars, as I now feel it is a more fairer system in relation to credits, with more viable options for users, but still obtaining quality output. I'm glad I waited out the many, many updated that occurred during October of 2025 onwards to be able to use the app happily around March/April 2026 onwards.

It's a fun enough app for ideas, but... I'm fine paying for the professional, but if you're going to limit how many, GET THE TEXT right. Half of the recreates are wrong or incomplete text. Also, my license here doesn't transfer to the PC. You have to pay for a whole extra year. If the app worked better, or I could use my licenses on PC and Android, I'd keep it. It's not worth the cost, but the free stuff is good for ideas to send to a better product for design.

I really like the old app till it started to deteriorate. So I decided to finally see what imagine was like. I loved it at first. I really like generating anime/fantasy type images. It started as good as first. Then a few updates changed the style of it. I'm not sure if this is the way it should be but I can't replicate what was made the first time. It all look different. The style image didn't match up to what image I was getting. I took the yearly subscription and I plan to continue to use it.

I used to love this app, but they took away the unlimited free generation ('paying' by watching an ad) and put many of the features which used to be free behind a paywall. Somehow, when they made this change, they also managed to make the generation buggy, so it only works half the time (but you still gotta watch an ad, even when it doesn't work!) The availability and concept used to really set this app apart, but after these changes, there's no good reason to choose it over others.

This app used to be "okay" when I first downloaded it.. now they don't allow you to do anything without purchasing pro. They cut back a lot of the features on the free version, & half the time the app doesn't generate anything close to what you input. It doesn't make me want to purchase their app, if anything makes me want to delete it and find a better one. Let's not get started on the ads... they already make money off the ads,so pushing a paid version that probably sucks just as much?nope

The free version is a little disappointing. You're stuck with the 1×1 aspect ratio, and you're limited to how many pictures you can produce during the day. Also, the speed and quality of the images produced are lower, and you have to watch an ad that is at least a minute long. There are pay versions at $6 a month, $40 a year, or $105 lifetime, but given the overall quality of images (a lot of my "humans had 6 and 7 fingers, objects generated looked disjointed) it's hardly worth paying for.

I once liked this app but now it became a bit greedy. Back then, I was able to generate images 3 times without having to watch an ad, but now not anymore. I have to watch no matter what just so I can create an image. Additionally, there were art styles that was once free, but now they aren't, the "Anime" art style was an example. You have to be in premium to access it when back then it was free.

Deceptive advertising. You guys want me to pay 6 bucks a week when I still don't have the option to save without a watermark? Even when you subscribe, you still can't just directly download the image. If you text it to yourself, you will still get the watermark. I think for 6 bucks a week, it's obvious we should be able to download without the watermark. You can easily do that with DaVinci.

It's nice but let's be real. Premium is way too overpriced and that's the only option we get if we want no ads. Plus if your not paying money you have a limit of how many things you can generate. So each day you can generate 5 or so things ai art for free. 5 THINGS! So not only are we forced to watch ads everytime we generate art but now we are being driven off the app unless we pay. Either we pay money or wait 24 hours to watch more ads to use the generator 5 times. Neither are desirable.

The images are clean and well done most of the time. However, the app has trouble with any detailed descriptions in producing an accurate depiction of what you are asking. if you don't want to pay for it, you get several very short adds for the first generations and then a couple of adds for the ones that come after. they aren't bad for the free creation of AI art.

Not free. The description says free with ads, but its more of a free trial. You get three uses of the app, and then you hit a pay wall. I took away a star for the bait and switch. I will say, I did like the quality of the artwork for the three trys I had. It was accurate and realistic. If I were looking for a low cost AI art generator, I would probably pick this one.

It does beautiful art, however I paid for the app and even if you pay, you can ask for limited pictures only per day. And 80% of the pictures creating fails, which is very annoying, considering there is limited number you can ask. To be fair, today 100% pictures creating failed. I asked for a refund. If I don't get it I remove one more star.

Well, I'm just gonna he objective here. - Most of the time the prompt aren't respected, it means you usually have to generate 10 pictures until it somehow follows your prompt. Clearly a way to just force people to pay more (I have a standard already and it's definitely to expensive for what it is). - The fonction resize and erase doesn't work at all. I literally pay for it, it always put a technical error. I truly wonder how this app is allowed on playstore.

I absolutely loved this app. Watch an ad, generate an image. I'd play with it when I was watching TV, and could generate and download unlimited images. Now today I find I have a limited number of free credits per day. That's irritating. I thought watching an ad was fair exchange for a generation but if I want to generate more than 5 images a day I have to buy Pro? Not impressed. Sad too because this app was fun and easy to use. Now I'll probably uninstall it.

worst app ever!!!!!! they didn't offer a free trial, which is okay. So I spent $15 to try them. I tried to do a video after 5 or 10 minutes. I stopped and then when I looked back at my credits, they were all gone. So I spent $15 for 1500 credits. All my credits were gone and my video didn't get made very, very bad app absolutely ridiculous. So basically a waste of 15 bucks for one month. I wish they would have did a trial. I could at least try them first. Before wasting $15.

Even with paying render times still lag. Probably 50% to 75% fail after waiting a long time. Does not seem to pick up prompts and negative prompts correctly. The different style selections mostly generate the same results regardless of what choice might be. Fun to play with for a while, but the hiccups are definitely annoying and not really worth paying for.

I had purchased the subscription to remove the watermark only for it to kick me the the main screen of the ap, not letting me download the image I had wanted in the first place, awful design choices were made on that. The single most frustrating part being that the image it had generated was perfect, exactly what I was looking for, and now I can't seem to get anything close to as good as that one. Also, the imagine v3 style has a weird obsession with making everything be inside a circle.

This app's algorithm provides well tuned results for graphic quality, but I didn't find that they related accurately to what I typed in, compared to others I've tried online. The ads are terrible, the value for your time doesn't feel like it's there for me. The subscription and lifetime fees are very expensive. If I didn't have to sit through 30-45 seconds of ads every single image, maybe I'd learn enough to think the pro version was worth it.

I understand the need for an app to evolve and stay relevant, but I have been using this app for more than 2 years and have been a paying customer (I don't mind paying for something I really like and use) but the latest changes left the original system of generating art nowhere to be found. I don't see a need to continue paying for an app that looks and works COMPLETELY different than what my favorite art generator used to do.

It's OK works for some things, I just think the fact they make you sit through the longest ads they can find to get a generated image that is sometimes not even remotely close to what you're after. Also why should I have to watch a 30-45 second ad to be told 'it's taking longer than expected, please retry.' I've uninstalled - ads are way too long - often doesn't give you accurately generated images - makes you sit through an ad to be told to retry. Looks like I'm gon try find another generator

First of all, the stupid "There seems to be a hiccup. The photo could not be processed" error is appearing everytime I want to create art. It's extremely annoying. I don't know why you put useless limitations, like aspect ratio, on the free version. The price isn't worth it. AI is supposed to be free, as you aren't training it. I can't believe how this exists. My device is rooted, and I can't use this damn app. I'll give this app 0 stars, only because Play Store wants to defend dumb developers.

I made a review before, but the app has gotten worse. Most of the style options seem to just force things into the product. I was trying to get a yellow jester and it gave me a girl in a bikini. If the app can't make your prompt, you have to watch a second ad to retry. One of the suggestions that the developers gave to fix this was to use a feature locked behind a paywall, and I've had this app for months and I have only gotten a single usable piece.

Asked it a few times for an image of a slug. Simplest requedt was "just a regular, normal slug." All results had a shell, so totally useless so far. Will try again tomorrow. Uploaded a line drawing, asked it to colour in the drawing in various ways. It altered the original image every time. Even when you specifically tell it to only add colour and nothing else. I found it very frustrating to use, and results were awful. I'm going to delete it.

I can't use the photo remix feature. It doesn't let me hit "done" after I select an image. I was really exited to have a cool image of myself generated thru this feature, too. So it's a real bummer that it's broken. The text prompt thing is alright, but I never quite got what I was looking for in terms of the image I wanted generated. But I was looking for something pretty niche, so that's expected.

Overwrote my prompt to the point that none of the specifications I had were still present and it homogenised it into the most blatantly basic prompt, boiling it down to the bare bones so it wouldn't have to actually make an effort to produce what was requested and could just spit out slop. Free version is limiting, purposely so, and the app tried to lock me into buying the premium the instant I downloaded it, almost crashing when I tried to close it. Do not use this.

Probably one of, if not the best AI generator for art. Any other that's out there is either payed or not good, makes disfigured people, etc. If you want some random art and are willing to watch an ad per picture, with tons of different styles, and what looks like a good premium version (I haven't tried it myself but it looks appealing), then get this. It is seriously good. And no, I'm not a bot, you can trust me.

Works far better than Wonder, however the prompts don't seem to impact the image at all whether you only use one word or a whole sentence. I like it, but it could use some work on even the vaguest of accuracy. For specifics, I did 12 images asking for beans, and only one had beans in it at all, the others were people, mermaids, cats with bows, everything but beans. Again though, at least the images showed up, definitely a better app than Wonder. Ads inconsistent at times sometimes showing 3.

Annoying app because the ai generation is actually great, and the different themes have enough to keep people going, however as there is no log in, (at least on free) your generated images aren't saved, your prompts aren't saved, and the excessive ads (1-2 per generation plus an additional 1-2 to upscale). I wouldn't care so much about the ads if it didn't have a 30% crash rate due to all the loading and games.

This App is very terrible. I didn't even get the chance for a free trial. While trying to navigate the App to explore their options, #41,000 was deducted from my Credit card and I didn't get the chance of a refund while not even getting any function for my money. If you can check the activity of my account on the App, you would notice I have not performed a single function with it and all my attempts at refund were rebuffed. I feel so bad that that kind of amount was wasted.

I loved this app and almost went pro .. and I still like it a lot . . . but recently I have run into a lot of failures. After sitting through the LONG ads, the app comes back with either a completely black or completely blue image (like a b.s.o.d. on Windows). Sometimes, I have to try 4 or 5 times to generate 1 image (yes, watching 4 or 5 ad sessions as well -- to get nothing). In fact, there are times when I can't get any image to generate, no matter how I change the prompt. Frustrating!!

Unfortunately I can't like this as much as I want to. The free generations require you to watch ads....only it often "fails" and you have to start again. Friends have paid for lifetime or yearly access and then when they upgrade the version they are dumped and can't get their money back. I see they have now removed the lifetime option with no notice. It's such a shame as I like the AI and I'd happily pay for the lifetime otherwise. Devs...prove me wrong!

Subscription option immediately in your face. Trying it out not possible without logging in, yet there's no visible option to log in. The "help" says an account can also be made on the website, which is unavailable on mobile. The app links to the "mobile web app", which links to the same website. Since trying before immediately forking over cash for who-knows-what isn't possible - uninstalled. If you toned down the money-grubbing, I might have given you some.

Despite my initial excitement, I ended up deleting the app. Maybe I haven't conquered the syntax needed for the image prompts, but unless the subjects are drawn from familiar tropes, you're out of luck. The results are ambiguous, off-script and, in some cases, disturbingly inaccurate in the number of limbs in groups of people or animals. So unless you're trying to create cute sci-fi/fantasy art or Dr. Moreau horror scenes, not so great.

Bought this a while ago. Paid for the entire software up front. I use to get unlimited generations. So many options to choose from. I used it constantly. Over the past few months. More and more options have been taken off the software. Including unlimited generations. ( Now allowed 250 a day) Extremely disappointed im the software. Not sure if they're trying to get me to subscribe to it after paying for everything already or if the app really is this terrible. I will be using a different app

There are more cons for this app than pros. Pros are that it does make very pleasing art, it's rather easy to use. Cons. Very long ads, some over 30seconds. Ad after every image even when your prompt gets rejected. It's very limited, you barely get to use any of its features for free. Now out of nowhere there's invisible 'credits' that lock you out of the small amount of free tools. Out of the three ai art generators I'm using, this one is the worst for user experience. 2 stars only for output

This app isnt bad and can be worth the money to not have to go through the constant ads and if you want to have the ability to sell the art, paying 6 dollars a month isnt terrible at all! The only reasons I have give this app a 3 star rating is because some of the art generated can be disfigured and it can be really bad looking and it happens more times that should be necessary and the saving feature. There should be a layout where you save your image and be able to find it with ease.

DON'T! Just DON'T! They do have wonderful advertising, but the app is nothing close to it! The options are short, and the effects are poor. The famous effect of bringing pictures to life is just a zoom transition. I bought a lifetime subscription, and I deeply regret doing so. The developers would have to improve it a LOT to make it worthy. The way it is now should be totally free, and even if it were, I would choose another option to create content.

A long time user, I used to love the app so much I was on it 24/7 but just a couple days ago an update came out and now I feel myself veering to other apps cause this one lost its spark, all my art pieces aren't the same. Now has a lack of creativity and a lot of basic pieces come out, even when I use very detailed lengthy prompts. Please bring back previous version! It was so good!

Yearly subscription and token system is misleading. I would love to add all the details of my experience, but it unfortunately takes more than five hundred characters. Just don't waste your money. The subscription gives you ad free, but you'll be paying again for tokens. Apparently, 16,000 tokens go away very quickly. Especially if you don't realize you spend tokens every image. Some templates cost more tokens than others(which you will NOT know unless you research.) Absolute waste.

Ive been using Imagine since it first offered lifetime purchase. The token system is a breach of contract as I bought the app when it offered free, unlimited generation. As you can see below, the staff said users have to buy tokens now-but this is not the agreement. You can't just change the business model completely AFTER purchase. I'd like a refund, but they'd probably come up with some BS to say no.

If you're hoping for NSFW or even sugestive art generation, look elsewhere. Overall, the app does work if you can look past the many ads it forces on you. Also, the amount of art you can make is severely limited unless you pay for an unlimited, higher quality and ad-free experience. I will say however, the AI upscaler does work pretty well and is able to upscale 4 images at once.

I really loved this app. I put up with the adds because the pics were awesome. I decided to go ahead and get the subscription. At first it was great but soon it started taking 60-90 seconds to generate a pic. That's how long it took with the add... then I lost access to several of the generator options. So now I basically have the same app I had before I paid for the yearly sub. I tried to get help from their team but everything keeps saying they are out of office.

This app filters your words so you can never get exactly what you want even with a premium option. It seems to filter anything that can construed as violent. Words such as stalking, as in a cat stalking a mouse, don't work. It took me over 3 hours of trying different combinations of words before I could get anything even close to what I asked for. Don't pay for this until the AI tech is perfected. This is a waste.

This AI makes beautiful generated pictures, the only thing that needs to be fixed is the variation, whenever I put something in and it generates it and I'm not satisfied, I'll change up the keywords a bit, generate it again and it still generates the same thing. Also, some of the keywords I put in the prompt are not generated in the picture. But other than that, pretty decent app.

Update DESTROYED this... I was loving this and getting amazing results. I've never spent money on an app before this, I bought the subscription, then out of nowhere, an update hits and all my results look like a kid drew them in paint and there are several bugs too. You can't switch styles without exiting and coming back in, can't change prompts without leaving and coming back. Generate button gray after you've changed styles...I'm so disappointed. I'll be canceling now. Only good ai app dead...

Dunno if we're allowed to review based on ads, but here we go. The demo is very difficult to use because there are so many unskippable, LONG ads. It was such a hassle that I just gave up after two generations. As for the ads themselves... they play dirty. I'm generally pretty on the ball with this stuff, but twice I had ads that finished but no button to close it came up. I hit the back button on my phone... and a thing pops up in the ad and ACTUALLY DOWNLOADS AND INSTALLS THE APP IN THE AD!

One star because after trying numerous times, I couldn't generate a single image. But, it still forced me to watch a 15-30 second ad each time I tried to generate anything, only to tell me there's an error after the fact. After five attempts, using increasingly more simple text promts and each image uses a different image style, I decided to heck with this app. Very unresponsive and difficult text generator. I have never had this problem in the past. One ad was impossible to end, also.

This is a fun app. I paid for subscription to gain more creative options and so far i am enjoying it very much. only downfall is that in order to use it on onother device I would have to pay again, which makes no sense if i'm already paing for it.
